module: Variant of the 'pretty' JSON encoder that only indents (multi-line formatting) down to a certain depth, to write readable jbeam files. It is not merged with the main encoder for performance reasons. A modder uses it to save a Lua table to a .jbeam file.
notes: writeFile encodes with maxLevel = 2: beyond depth 2, sub-tables are written on one line via the global jsonEncode. Exception: the 'components' key at level 1 is always fully formatted (maxLevel 999).
Object keys are sorted (tableKeysSorted). Numbers use %.10g; NaN/infinities become 9e999 / -9e999. vec3/quat (cdata) are written {"x":..,"y":..,"z":..[,"w":..]}.

The file is opened for writing ('w') and overwritten. It depends on game globals: jsonEncode, tableKeysSorted, ffi, log, dumps. The numberPrecision parameter passed to the encoder is a global variable `numberPrecision` (nil unless defined elsewhere), so normally undefined.

writeFile.desc: Writes the table obj to filename in depth-limited pretty JSON format. Returns true on success; if opening fails, logs an error and returns false.

filename.desc: path of the file to write (overwritten)
